Sorts the items by a number and keeps the first few, e.g. the five markets with the most liquidity.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `transform.top` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Sort by (`field`) | text | yes |  | A numeric field, e.g. liquidity, volume24h or absChangePct. Names a field of the items it receives, a number or decimal one; saving checks the items have it. |
| Order (`order`) | text | no | `desc` | One of `desc`, `asc`. |
| Keep (`limit`) | whole number | no | `10` | How many items to keep. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on as they are.
